title: Jesus Comes

summary.younger: God the Son was born as a baby named Jesus. He healed people, taught about God's kingdom, and showed what God is like.
summary.older: God keeps his promises in person. Jesus, born of Mary, announces that God's kingdom has come near, heals and forgives, calls twelve disciples, and speaks with an authority that belongs to God alone.

added: Act Nine (Christ, the Center) is two stops here: Jesus comes, then the cross and the empty tomb.
